transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been struggling with a persistently sunken mood for the past three months. I just feel an overwhelming sense of sadness and a deep, hollow emptiness inside me all the time.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or needed significantly less sleep than usual, even if you are feeling down now?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. In fact, I’ve been having a lot of trouble sleeping and I just don't have the motivation to do anything at all.
Have you felt this way most of the time for at least two years, or has this current period of sadness been limited to the last three months?
It has definitely been limited to the last three months. I haven't been feeling this way for two years; this all started recently.
